newsitem.title: CHINA: Hundreds queue up in HK to buy handover stamps.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds queue up in HK to buy handover stamps.

text.p: Hundreds queued from early morning outside Hong Kong's post offices on Sunday to buy stamps portraying late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, issued by China to mark the territory's return to Chinese rule.
The stamps have a face value of 50 Chinese yuan (US$6) and a cover decorated with drawings of Hong Kong, returned to China at midnight on June 30 after 156 years of British colonial rule.
"I am not very keen on stamp collecting. But I'm particularly interested in this one. It has commemorative value," said one buyer.
Other customers were speculators expecting the stamps to appreciate in value. "I will sell it to a philately society," said one.
